Overview

Warri is a city in Delta with a population of 560,000. A major oil and gas hub in the Niger Delta region of Nigeria, known for its industrial activity and diverse culture. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 18.0.
